description: Admin UI surface for managing mcp_policy_rules. Must include: rule listing (rule_type, pattern, verdict_action, priority), create/edit form with regex validation for pattern field, enable/disable toggle, and hit count display. Ports to localhost:8790. Reads via write_service :8772 /query, writes via :8772/write. Table columns from DB_SCHEMA.md: rule_id, rule_type, pattern, verdict_action, priority, is_enabled, created_at.
